review_comments.body: **Invalid seeds return server errors** An out-of-range `seed`, such as `2147483648`, returns a plain `fmt.Errorf`. `CheckContextAndGetRequestBody` treats that as an internal failure, so clients receive HTTP 500 instead of 400 and may retry a request that cannot succeed. Use `providerUtils.InvalidRequestErrorf` to mark this as bad caller input. ```suggestion return config, providerUtils.InvalidRequestErrorf("seed must be between %d and %d for Gemini generationConfig.seed, got %d", math.MinInt32, math.MaxInt32, *params.Seed) ```

**Converter tests are split unnecessarily** This new file tests the same converter already covered by `chat_test.go`. `AGENTS.md` explicitly requires adding tests to the existing file that covers the code. Move these tests and the benchmark there before merging to satisfy that requirement and keep the coverage together. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/c39fa27b2182363fd1c94a9082ff02c89b2ab5c7/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Seed forwarding lacks end-to-end tests** This changes the request sent to Gemini and Vertex, but the new tests stop at the converted struct. `AGENTS.md` requires a provider-harness case for every wire-visible change. Before merging, add cases in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` that check the outgoing `generationConfig.seed`, including zero. Check the sent value rather than relying on repeated model output being identical. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/c39fa27b2182363fd1c94a9082ff02c89b2ab5c7/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win**
Supported by static analysis
Script executed: ```bash rg -n 'CheckContextAndGetRequestBody|InvalidRequestErrorf|convertParamsToGenerationConfig|ToGeminiChatCompletionRequest' core/providers/gemini core/providers/utils sed -n '1550,1610p' core/providers/gemini/utils.go ``` Repository: maximhq/bifrost Length of output: 17086 --- Script executed: ```bash sed -n '2695,2745p' core/providers/utils/utils.go echo '-----' sed -n '3448,3500p' core/providers/utils/utils.go echo '-----' sed -n '366,392p' core/providers/gemini/gemini.go echo '-----' rg -n -F -e 'StatusCode: schemas.Ptr(400)' -e 'AsBifrostBadRequestError' -e 'IsRetryable' -- core/providers/utils core/schemas | head -n 40 || test "$?" -eq 1 ``` Repository: maximhq/bifrost Length of output: 7420 ---
**Return a 400 for an out-of-range seed.** The plain `fmt.Errorf` at `core/providers/gemini/utils.go:1585` is not a caller-invalid error. `CheckContextAndGetRequestBody` wraps it as an internal conversion error, which the HTTP layer returns as a 500. A client that sends an out-of-range seed gets a server-error response for an invalid request. Return `providerUtils.InvalidRequestErrorf` so the error is promoted to a 400.
🐛 Suggested fix
```diff --- "a/core/providers/gemini/utils.go" +++ "b/core/providers/gemini/utils.go" @@ -1582,7 +1582,7 @@ } if params.Seed != nil { if *params.Seed < math.MinInt32 || *params.Seed > math.MaxInt32 { - return config, fmt.Errorf("seed must be between %d and %d for Gemini generationConfig.seed, got %d", math.MinInt32, math.MaxInt32, *params.Seed) + return config, providerUtils.InvalidRequestErrorf("seed must be between %d and %d for Gemini generationConfig.seed, got %d", math.MinInt32, math.MaxInt32, *params.Seed) } seed := int32(*params.Seed) config.Seed = &seed ```
Add the `providerUtils` import to `core/providers/gemini/utils.go` if the file does not already import it.
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements. ```suggestion return config, providerUtils.InvalidRequestErrorf("seed must be between %d and %d for Gemini generationConfig.seed, got %d", math.MinInt32, math.MaxInt32, *params.Seed) ```

Script executed: ```bash set -u echo "== ctx.go compat header handling" sed -n '765,820p' transports/bifrost-http/lib/ctx.go echo "== compat plugin model-list drop logic" sed -n '180,200p' plugins/compat/main.go echo "== dropparams seed handling" sed -n '112,125p' plugins/compat/dropparams.go echo "== gemini int32 seed check" sed -n '1578,1592p' core/providers/gemini/utils.go echo "== datasheet supported-parameter lookup" sed -n '225,260p' framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/params.go echo "== harness collection prerequest and status script" sed -n '20,62p' tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json echo "== harness case 297.3 status script" sed -n '302700,302747p' tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json echo "== Makefile COMPAT default" rg -n -F -e 'COMPAT' -- Makefile || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "== gemini-2.5-flash entries mentioning seed in datasheet or catalog data" rg -n -F --glob '*.json' -e 'gemini-2.5-flash' -- . || test "$?" -eq 1 ``` Repository: maximhq/bifrost Length of output: 45662 ---
**Skip case 297.3 when compat is on.** With `COMPAT=on` or `COMPAT=both`, the harness sends `x-bf-compat: true`. That header enables `should_drop_params`. If the model catalog returns a non-empty supported-parameter list for `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash` that omits `seed`, compat sets `seed` to nil before Gemini validates it. Gemini then sends no seed and returns 200. The `[EXPECT-400]` status check then fails for 297.3. Case 297.3 needs a compat-specific skip. Its non-compat 400 assertion must stay. Add a compat-only skip tag and keep `[EXPECT-400]` on the case:
Suggested fix
```diff "if (__compat) { pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'x-bf-compat', value: String(__compat) }); }", + "// Compat drops seed when the catalog list omits it, so this row cannot expect a 400.", + "if (__compat && name.indexOf('[COMPAT-SKIP]') !== -1) {", + " pm.execution.skipRequest();", + "}", ``` ```diff - "name": "297.3 [EXPECT-400] gemini/gemini-2.5-flash chat seed above int32 is a client error (gemini seed)", + "name": "297.3 [EXPECT-400] [COMPAT-SKIP] gemini/gemini-2.5-flash chat seed above int32 is a client error (gemini seed)", ```
The prerequest block already reads `name` and defines `__compat`. The new branch reuses both values. The skip runs before the request is sent, so the collection-level status check does not run for that row in compat runs. The `[EXPECT-400]` tag stays in the name. Non-compat runs still send the request and still require HTTP 400 with an error naming `seed`.
